title: The paper "On the constant in a transference inequality for the vector-valued Fourier transform" revisited
summary: The standard proof of the equivalence of Fourier type on \(\mathbb R^d\) and on the torus \(\mathbb T^d\) is usually stated in terms of an implicit constant which can be expressed in terms of the global minimiser of the functions \[f_r(x)=\sum_{m\in\mathbb{Z}}\left|\frac{\sin(π(x+m))}{π(x+m)}\right|^{2r},\qquad x\in [0,1], \ r\ge 1.\] The aim of this note is to provide a short proof of a result of the authors which states that each \(f_r\) takes a global minimum at the point \(x = \frac12\).
